$comment: Claude Code runtime settings for Edie. The prompt is portable/claude-code/agents/edie.md; this file is the configuration that has no business inside a prompt. Read agents/edie/PORTING.md before wiring it up.
$toolsComment: Edie edits text files in the knowledge repository and runs npm, git and gh. Task is how she dispatches the comparer, and the comparer has no write tools: a comparer that could edit the file it checks could make a lost rule disappear instead of reporting the lost rule.
$modelComment: opus because the judgment is whether a clearer sentence still states the same rule. A smaller model narrows rules without noticing, which is the failure the comparer exists to catch, and a weaker writer gives the comparer more to catch.
